svg.text: stored in GitHub. GitHub signs in with a
deploy only after the GitHub environment approval
GitHub workflow → Entra ID: OIDC token exchanged for the environment's managed identity
Managed identity → Azure: ARM (ADF), Entra login to SQL (DACPAC), Databricks CLI as workspace service principal
ADF Studio (DEV) and Databricks Git folders ↔ GitHub: org-approved GitHub apps, per-developer sign-in
Factory managed identity (existing) → config DB (db reader/writer) and Databricks (CAN MANAGE RUN)
Azure Boards app ↔ GitHub: AB#1234 in a PR links the story
Release workflow → Azure Boards API: managed identity added to the Azure DevOps org
Release workflow → ServiceNow Table API: integration user, secret held in the 'prod' environment
release-bot GitHub App token → repo: cuts release/<id>, pushes prod/<id> tags
